title: Open Wikipedia articles in Wikiwand
question: How do I make Wikipedia links open in Wikiwand?
answer: Wikipedia has no option to send its articles to Wikiwand; you need an extension or a userscript. The usermods script on this page redirects any Wikipedia article you open, from a search result or a link, to the same article on Wikiwand in the same language, before the Wikipedia page loads. Edit and history pages, talk pages and special pages stay on Wikipedia. Without a userscript, Wikiwand's own browser extension does the redirect and adds more features.
prompt: Redirect Wikipedia articles to the same article on Wikiwand.
details:
The script runs before the page draws and swaps `https://<lang>.wikipedia.org/wiki/<Article>` for `https://www.wikiwand.com/<lang>/<Article>`, keeping the section anchor. It uses `location.replace`, so the Back button skips the Wikipedia page.

It leaves Wikipedia alone for edit, history, diff and old revision views, the Main Page, and pages in the English non-article namespaces such as Talk:, User:, File: and Special:. On other language editions those namespace names are translated and are sent to Wikiwand too. When the browser reports a wikiwand.com page as the referrer, the script does not redirect, so a link from Wikiwand back to Wikipedia is not sent straight back. The check loads one English article.

alternatives.title: Wikiwand extension
alternatives.body: Wikiwand's official Chrome extension redirects Wikipedia links to Wikiwand and adds its own features on top.

alternatives.title: Change the address by hand
alternatives.body: Replace `en.wikipedia.org/wiki/` with `www.wikiwand.com/en/` in the address bar.
